preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The length of each string s is between 1 and 100,000 characters, inclusive.
Each string s consists only of lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the self-similarity of the string s[i] for each test case i
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the sum of the number of occurrences of each substring p in s as a substring, where the sum is over all nonempty strings p.
